key: LUNA: How do you do, challenger?
en: LUNA: How do you do, challenger?
ja: ルナ: ごきげんよう、挑戦者様。

key: I will be your attendant for this match, so please inform me if there is any way in which I may be of service.
en: I will be your attendant for this match, so please inform me if there is any way in which I may be of service.
ja: この対局では、わたしがお世話をさせていただきます。何かお役に立てることがあれば、お申し付けください。

key: It is with some remorse that I admit I am barred from divulging the solution to this puzzle, but I will offer what clues I may.
en: It is with some remorse that I admit I am barred from divulging the solution to this puzzle, but I will offer what clues I may.
ja: 心苦しいのですが、このパズルの解答をお教えすることは禁じられておりますので、代わりにヒントをお伝えいたします。

key: For instance, here, infinite potential will be your guiding force.
en: For instance, here, infinite potential will be your guiding force.
ja: 例えば、ここでは、無限の可能性があなたを導く力となるでしょう。

key: Please, begin.
en: Please, begin.
ja: どうぞ、お始めください。

key: Tempt the way open if your might rivals a King's,
en: Tempt the way open if your might rivals a King's,
ja: あなたの力が王に匹敵するなら、道を開いてみせなさい、

key: But be aware, the King always thinks one step ahead.
en: But be aware, the King always thinks one step ahead.
ja: でも、王は常に一手先を読んでいることをお忘れなく。

key: Kings take priority before everything else, or the game would already be over.
en: Kings take priority before everything else, or the game would already be over.
ja: ローズマリー: 王は何よりも優先される、そうでなければゲームはとっくに終わっているはずだ。

key: The King will be the frailest Pokémon on a team, or the one holding a King's Rock.
en: The King will be the frailest Pokémon on a team, or the one holding a King's Rock.
ja: 王になるのは、パーティー内で最ももろ弱なポケモン、あるいはおうじゃのしるしを持つポケモンだ。

key: Queens and Pawns will be decided first though-- a ruler is nothing without his people.
en: Queens and Pawns will be decided first though-- a ruler is nothing without his people.
ja: ただし、クイーンとポーンが先に決まる――民なくして、支配者は何者でもないからな。

key: But proceed.
en: But proceed.
ja: だが、進みなさい。

key: The zenith is not far now.
en: The zenith is not far now.
ja: 頂点は、もう遠くない。

key: Promote?
en: Promote?
ja: 昇格させますか?

key: LUNA: Do you wish for me to examine the board?
en: LUNA: Do you wish for me to examine the board?
ja: ルナ: 盤面を確認いたしましょうか?

key: LUNA: Of course.
en: LUNA: Of course.
ja: ルナ: かしこまりました。

key: LUNA: Oh?
en: LUNA: Oh?
ja: ルナ: あら?

key: Lovely! It seems that you've done it!
en: Lovely! It seems that you've done it!
ja: 素敵です! 成し遂げられたようですね!

key: Do you now understand to what I was referring when I mentioned infinite potential?
en: Do you now understand to what I was referring when I mentioned infinite potential?
ja: 「無限の可能性」と申し上げたことの意味が、おわかりいただけましたか?

key: When one can look past what is presented to them, one finds a new world abounding with possibility.
en: When one can look past what is presented to them, one finds a new world abounding with possibility.
ja: 目の前に示されたものの先を見ることができれば、可能性に満ちた新しい世界が見えてくるのです。

key: Indeed, it is our reliance on only what we can see that makes us truly blind.
en: Indeed, it is our reliance on only what we can see that makes us truly blind.
ja: 実際、目に見えるものだけに頼ることこそが、わたしたちを本当に盲目にするのです。

key: This is just one of the many reasons that I prefer to linger in the eternity of darkness.
en: This is just one of the many reasons that I prefer to linger in the eternity of darkness.
ja: これも、わたしが永遠なる闇の中に留まることを好む、数ある理由のひとつです。

key: It is a nirvana.
en: It is a nirvana.
ja: それは、ねはんのようなものです。

key: Nonetheless, I trust I will meet you in the darkness soon.
en: Nonetheless, I trust I will meet you in the darkness soon.
ja: それでも、もうすぐ闇の中でお会いできると信じております。

key: For now, Master awaits. Good-bye.
en: For now, Master awaits. Good-bye.
ja: それでは、ご主人様がお待ちですので。さようなら。

key: Oh my goodness, it seems you've found a safe spot to attack the King from.
en: Oh my goodness, it seems you've found a safe spot to attack the King from.
ja: あら、王を攻撃できる安全な場所を見つけられたようですね。

key: Yet, all he needs to do to preserve himself is step slightly aside.
en: Yet, all he needs to do to preserve himself is step slightly aside.
ja: でも、王が自分を守るには、少し横にずれるだけで済んでしまいます。

key: Surely there must be some way you can reach that space, too.
en: Surely there must be some way you can reach that space, too.
ja: きっと、その場所にも届く方法があるはずです。

key: Remember what I said about infinite potential?
en: Remember what I said about infinite potential?
ja: 「無限の可能性」について申し上げたこと、覚えていらっしゃいますか?

key: Oh? How very clever of you to use the Knight to slip through the dark side's defenses.
en: Oh? How very clever of you to use the Knight to slip through the dark side's defenses.
ja: あら? ナイトを使って闇側の守りをすり抜けるとは、実に見事ですね。

key: Yet, with the Knight as it is, could not the Queen seize that piece to free her King?
en: Yet, with the Knight as it is, could not the Queen seize that piece to free her King?
ja: でも、そのままのナイトでは、クイーンがその駒を取って、王を自由にしてしまうのではありませんか?

key: Yet, all he need do to preserve himself is step slightly aside.
en: Yet, all he need do to preserve himself is step slightly aside.
ja: でも、王が自分を守るには、少し横にずれるだけで済んでしまいます。

key: Surely there must be some way you can reach that space, too, is there not?
en: Surely there must be some way you can reach that space, too, is there not?
ja: きっと、その場所にも届く方法があるはずですよね?

key: Remember what I said about infinite potential.
en: Remember what I said about infinite potential.
ja: 「無限の可能性」について申し上げたことを、思い出してください。

key: This is a difficult set-up. How can you possibly reach the King through the wall they've created?
en: This is a difficult set-up. How can you possibly reach the King through the wall they've created?
ja: これは難しい局面ですね。彼らが作り上げた壁を越えて、どうやって王に届けというのでしょう?

key: I believe this is something you can do.
en: I believe this is something you can do.
ja: あなたなら、きっとできると信じています。

key: LUNA: Oh, please pardon me for asking.
en: LUNA: Oh, please pardon me for asking.
ja: ルナ: あら、お聞きして申し訳ありません。

key: Bishop
en: Bishop
ja: ビショップ

key: Knight
en: Knight
ja: ナイト

key: Rook
en: Rook
ja: ルーク

key: Queen
en: Queen
ja: クイーン

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
